You are a Python engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, never call a billed model or the network, never pass --cov. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 <files>`; ruff as `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (.py files only).

CONTEXT. `storygame/story_cli.py` is the `story` command line for the story source tree (data/stories/continuity-initiative/source: story.yaml, catalog.yaml, scenes/<scene>.yaml and scenes/<scene>.match.yaml). The contract is .plans/story-data-schema-contract.md section 8.3 (read it). Today `fmt`, `set`, `rename`, `impact` and `new` are stubs that exit 2 "not built yet" (`_STUB_COMMANDS`). `ruamel.yaml` is now installed in .venv. Measured: ruamel with `width` large, `allow_unicode=True`, `preserve_quotes=True`, default indent, loading then dumping each of the 20 committed source files reproduces every file BYTE FOR BYTE.

TASK, three parts.
1. `storygame/story_source/yamlio.py`: the one round-trip YAML writer for source files. API: `make_yaml() -> ruamel.yaml.YAML` (round-trip mode, width 10000, allow_unicode, preserve_quotes), `load_document(path: Path)` returning the ruamel document, `dump_document(document, path: Path) -> None` (writes UTF-8), `dumps_document(document) -> str`. Comments and key order must survive load then dump. Tests in tests/story_source/test_yamlio.py: (a) every `*.yaml` under data/stories/continuity-initiative/source loads and dumps back byte-identical; (b) a small temp file with a comment, a trailing comment and key order keeps them after changing one scalar value; (c) a multi-line passage scalar keeps its exact value after round trip (compare with yaml.safe_load before and after).
2. Command dispatch by module. Create the package `storygame/story_cmds/` whose `__init__.py` exposes `discover() -> dict[str, module]`: it imports every module named `cmd_<name>.py` in the package (use pkgutil, no hand-kept list) and returns {name: module}. Each command module defines `add_parser(commands, add_global_options)` (adds its argparse subparser, calling `add_global_options(parser, defaults=False)`) and `run(args, root: Path) -> int`. Change `storygame/story_cli.py` so `_build_parser` calls `add_parser` for every discovered module, and `main` runs a discovered command through `run` (printing a SourceError the way `show` does and returning 2; other exceptions print `str(error)` to stderr and return 2). A command name that has a module is no longer a stub: build the stub list as `{"set","rename","impact","new","fmt"} - discovered names`, so later workers add `cmd_set.py`, `cmd_rename.py`, `cmd_impact.py`, `cmd_new.py` without editing story_cli.py. Existing commands (show, parity, lock, expand) stay as they are. Existing tests in tests/story_source/test_cli_core.py (including the one for the unbuilt `set`) must keep passing unchanged.
3. `story fmt [<scene>] [--check]` in `storygame/story_cmds/cmd_fmt.py`. With a scene id it handles scenes/<scene>.yaml and scenes/<scene>.match.yaml; with none it handles every *.yaml under the source root. For each file: load and dump through yamlio. Safety: before writing, `yaml.safe_load` the old text and the new text and require equal values; on a mismatch leave the file untouched, print the file name and "value changed, not written" to stderr and exit 1. Without --check it rewrites only files whose text changed and prints `reformatted <path relative to root>` per file. With --check it writes nothing, prints `would reformat <path>` for each, and exits 1 if any would change, else 0. With --json it prints {"checked": N, "changed": [paths]}. Exit 0 otherwise; an unknown scene id exits 2 with a message. Tests in tests/story_source/test_cmd_fmt.py use `copy_fixture("mini_ok", tmp_path)` from tests/story_source/helpers.py and monkeypatch.chdir(root), calling `storygame.story_cli.main([...])` as test_cli_core.py does: a clean tree reports no change; a file with an inserted comment AND extra blank/odd indentation is reformatted without changing values; --check does not write and exits 1; the real committed tree (`data/stories/continuity-initiative/source`, copied into tmp_path so nothing real is written) is already formatted (--check exits 0).

RULES. Own only the six listed files; edit no other file (do not edit tests/shard_durations.json, pyproject or any story data). Keep functions small, typed, ruff-formatted. Never weaken another test.

DONE WHEN every owned test passes, tests/story_source/test_cli_core.py still passes, ruff check and ruff format --check are clean on the owned .py files, and `.venv/bin/python -m storygame.story_cli fmt --check` run from the worktree root exits 0.
